Test Description: Send a single valid local packet with minimum payload (1 byte)
Pass Criteria: Payload+CRC forwarded correctly on local output; no drop_cnt increment

Test Description: Send multiple back-to-back local packets
Pass Criteria: All packets forwarded in order; no drops

Test Description: Send local packet with maximum payload (255 bytes)
Pass Criteria: All 255 bytes + CRC forwarded correctly

Test Description: Verify CRC16 forwarded unchanged for local traffic
Pass Criteria: data_local stream ends with same CRC16 as input

Test Description: Verify FRAG_NUM must be 1 for local packets; FRAG_NUM!=1 should be dropped
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments by 1; no local output
Notes: Per spec FRAG_NUM shall equal 1 for local

Test Description: Single-fragment remote packet (FRAG_NUM=1 only)
Pass Criteria: Merged payload+new CRC16 output on remote interface

Test Description: Two-fragment remote packet arriving in order
Pass Criteria: Fragments merged in FRAG_NUM order; new CRC16 correct

Test Description: Multi-fragment remote packet arriving out of order
Pass Criteria: Output payload matches in-order concatenation regardless of arrival order

Test Description: Maximum fragment count (up to 31 fragments)
Pass Criteria: All 31 fragments accumulated and output correctly

Test Description: Verify new CRC16 is generated over merged payload
Pass Criteria: CRC16 in remote output matches recomputed CRC over merged payload

Test Description: Verify cfg is NOT transmitted on remote output
Pass Criteria: data_remote stream contains only merged payload + CRC16

Test Description: Verify only one remote packet accumulated at a time
Pass Criteria: Second simultaneous SEQ_NUM causes drop; first packet completes normally

Test Description: Verify valid/ready transfer rule (transfer only when vld=1 AND rdy=1)
Pass Criteria: No data lost or duplicated when rdy toggles

Test Description: Verify stability rule: signals remain stable when vld=1 and rdy=0 (backpressure)
Pass Criteria: Scoreboard detects no signal change during stall; packet received correctly

Test Description: Local output backpressure: local_rdy=0 during transfer
Pass Criteria: DUT deasserts in_rdy or holds local output until consumer ready

Test Description: Remote output backpressure: remote_rdy=0 during transfer
Pass Criteria: DUT holds remote output correctly under backpressure

Test Description: cfg sampled on first payload byte when in_vld=1 and in_rdy=1
Pass Criteria: TRAFFIC_TYPE SEQ_NUM FRAG_NUM PAYLOAD_LEN decoded correctly

Test Description: Verify TRAFFIC_TYPE bit correctly classifies local vs remote
Pass Criteria: Local: data_local valid; Remote: data_remote valid

Test Description: SEQ_NUM == 0 causes silent drop
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments by 1; no output produced

Test Description: FRAG_NUM == 0 causes silent drop
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments by 1; no output produced

Test Description: PAYLOAD_LEN == 0 causes silent drop
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments by 1; no output produced

Test Description: PAYLOAD_LEN > 255 is invalid (cfg field is 8-bit so wrap-around not possible; test PAYLOAD_LEN=0)
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments; no output

Test Description: Reserved bits [7:1] non-zero causes silent drop
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments by 1; no output produced

Test Description: Reserved bits [23:21] non-zero causes silent drop
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments by 1; no output produced

Test Description: Reserved bits [31:29] non-zero causes silent drop
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments by 1; no output produced

Test Description: Fragment with mismatched SEQ_NUM while packet being accumulated causes drop
Pass Criteria: Buffered packet dropped; drop_cnt increments once per dropped packet

Test Description: FRAG_NUM=1 arriving while a different SEQ_NUM packet is incomplete causes drop
Pass Criteria: Previous packet dropped; drop_cnt increments; new packet may start

Test Description: Missing fragment (gap in FRAG_NUM sequence) causes drop
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt increments; no remote output for that packet

Test Description: drop_cnt increments by exactly 1 per dropped packet regardless of fragment count
Pass Criteria: Counter value matches expected number of dropped packets

Test Description: drop_cnt wraps around at 2^16 (modulo-65536)
Pass Criteria: Counter wraps from 0xFFFF to 0x0000 correctly

Test Description: drop_cnt not affected by successful transmissions
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt stays 0 after successful packets

Test Description: Reset deasserts all valid outputs (local_vld=0 remote_vld=0)
Pass Criteria: Outputs deasserted during rst_n=0

Test Description: Reset clears drop_cnt to zero
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt=0 immediately after reset

Test Description: Reset discards any packet in progress
Pass Criteria: Partial remote packet discarded on reset; no output produced

Test Description: Normal operation resumes after reset deassertion
Pass Criteria: Packets transfer correctly after rst_n goes high

Test Description: Interleaved local and remote packets
Pass Criteria: Both routed correctly; no cross-contamination

Test Description: Random mix of valid and invalid packets
Pass Criteria: drop_cnt matches expected count; valid packets output correctly

Test Description: Achieve >90% code coverage
Pass Criteria: Coverage report shows >90% line/branch coverage

Test Description: Achieve >90% functional coverage across all covergroups
Pass Criteria: Coverage report shows >90% functional coverage
